verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Stripe tracks captures, refunds, partial/over-captures and force captures with reconciliation via metadata back to card and purchase (doc-21), and disputes (chargebacks) can be created and monitored via API (doc-11), implying webhook-driven, identifier-based event tracking. However, the pack lacks explicit documentation of webhook event types (e.g. issuing_transaction.created, issuing_dispute.updated) or explicit 'stable transaction identifier' guarantees for reversals specifically. Missing for 10: explicit webhook event catalog for post-auth events, documented stable transaction/dispute IDs, and independent confirmation that ledger reconciliation via webhooks works reliably in production.
